text.description_html:
PDQ 6200 Series 36 Inch Door Commercial Vertical Rod Exit Device

The PDQ 6200 Series offers superior durability and security in commercial applications while providing compliance with life safety and fire code requirements. This Vertical Rod Exit Device For 36 Inch Doors is non-handed.

Fasteners are furnished for both wood and metal door applications. Fire labeled devices are furnished standard with sex nuts. These exit devices are listed by U.L./U.L.C. and comply with U.L. 10C and UBC 7-2 (1997) for positive pressure.

Meets requirements of the Buy American Act. ADA compliant and ICC/ANSI 117.1 for accessible and usable buildings.

Features and Specifications for the PDQ 6200V Vertical Rod Exit Device:

  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Chassis: Corrosion resistant plated steel.
  • Rail: Extruded aluminum.
  • Touch Pad: Stainless steel
  • Backset: 2-3/4" backset, compatible with 161 prep.
  • Top Latch Bolt: Pullman with dead latching 5/8" throw
  • Bottom Latch Bolt: Pullman with 5/8" throw, held retracted during door swing.
  • Projection: 3-1/16" projection
  • Hand: Device is non-handed
  • Dogging: No dogging on fire labeled devices.
  • Application: Surface Vertical Rod (7'0" tall door standard)
  • Stile Width: 4-1/4" maximum
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Door Width: Standard 3'0" door maximum
  • Door Height: Standard Up to 7' High Door.
  • Certifications: U.L./U.L.C. listed for "Panic", "Fire Exit Hardware" labeled for up to 1-1/2 hour for 3'0" x 7'0" maximum single, 6'0" x 7'0" maximum pairs / Complies with U.L. 10C and UBC 7.2 (1997)
